findings.description: The completion test explicitly requires the detector, registry, and baseline to be pure, deterministic, and bounded, but the proposed acceptance only pins those properties for the detector and baseline. The registry path is not required to be pure or deterministic, and the detector is not explicitly required to have bounded traversal behavior on large repositories.
findings.recommendation: Add acceptance language and tests that detector and registry resolution are pure, deterministic, network-free, mutation-free, and bounded under large or pathological repo layouts.

findings.description: The plan requires bounded scanning and honest coverage ceilings, but it does not specify what the graph or coverage block reports when a repo exceeds scan limits. Without an explicit truncation or limit-hit signal, a bounded baseline could omit nodes or heuristic edges while still appearing complete enough to mislead the operator.
findings.recommendation: Define a deterministic scan-limit/truncation marker that feeds the coverage block and caps confidence when inventory or heuristic import extraction stops before the full repo is examined.
